verdict.rationale: Zep documents attribute-based access control (ABAC) policies attached to API keys and UserGroups explicitly designed to limit which actions and context each agent or Memory MCP user can reach, i.e. scoped/least-privilege credentials for agents (zep-docs-25, zep-docs-38, zep-docs-42, zep-docs-12, zep-docs-31). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the ABAC policy mechanics and no concrete example of issuing a scoped key in practice.
